patch_description:
Replaces the current ansatz block with a more parameter-efficient 4-parameter design by:
- Using a single shared RZ parameter across all qubits for both the pre- and post-entanglement layers (same param key reused).
- Keeping only two shared RY parameters for the (0–3) and (4–7) qubit banks.
- Using just two shared CRZ strength parameters: one for the interleaved ring pattern and one for the opposite chords.
- Reordering the internal block to RZ_pre → CRZ(entangle) → RY → RZ_post to improve information flow while keeping the same overall circuit wiring/depth pattern.
This reduces N_PARAMS (per block) substantially while maintaining strong expressivity via the CRZ entangling structure.
